name: Provider Profile Structure
description: Freelancer profile with title, bio/overview, skills tags, work history, education/certifications, portfolio samples, hourly rate, availability setting, languages, and profile photo; completeness percentage is tracked and gates feature access.
evidence_quote: A complete profile increases your ranking in Upwork search results… Completing your profile unlocks features like the Connects program, allowing you to submit proposals to clients.

name: Job Success Score (JSS)
description: Numeric reputation score (0–100%) calculated daily from client feedback, contract-ending history, and long-term relationship signals across 6-, 12-, and 24-month windows; the best window score is displayed on the profile.
evidence_quote: We calculate JSS daily based on your 6-, 12- and 24-month history in the marketplace, calculating a score for each timeframe, and display the best of these scores on your profile.

name: Mutual Contract Review (Feedback)
description: After a contract closes, both provider and client have 14 days to leave a star-rated review for each other; reviews inform JSS and are visible on the provider's public profile.
evidence_quote: When a contract ends, you and the client have 14 days to leave a review for each other. Leaving professional, quality feedback for your client often encourages them to reciprocate, which is vital for building a strong profile.

name: Rising Talent Badge
description: Entry-level status badge awarded to promising new freelancers who meet criteria including 100% profile completeness, no negative feedback, identity-verified badge, and either an Upwork invitation or 4.8+ avg rating with ≥$250 earned in 12 months.
evidence_quote: To earn the badge as a freelancer… Have an average star rating of 4.8 or above and earned at least $250 USD in the past 12 months… Have a Job Success Score (JSS) of 90% or higher, if you've earned one.

name: Top Rated Badge
description: Earned by the top 10% of freelancers; requires JSS ≥90%, ≥$1,000 12-month earnings, 100% complete profile, 90+ days on platform, and Rising Talent status or 90%+ JSS for at least 13 of the last 16 weeks; unlocks job digest email, faster payments, and consultation offering.
evidence_quote: A current Job Success Score of 90% or higher… Maintained Rising Talent status or a Job Success Score of at least 90% for at least 13 of the last 16 weeks… 12-month earnings of at least $1,000.

name: Top Rated Plus Badge
description: Awarded to the top 3% of performers with proven success on high-value or long-term contracts; criteria are a superset of Top Rated requirements with emphasis on large-contract history.
evidence_quote: To earn a Top Rated Plus badge, you must display proven success on large or long-term contracts… If you become Top Rated Plus, you will represent the top 3% of performers on Upwork.

name: Expert-Vetted Badge
description: Invitation-only badge for the top 1% of talent, requiring a 30-minute skills interview with Upwork Talent Managers; grants visibility to Enterprise and Business Plus clients only, plus priority access to Fortune 500 projects and a dedicated Talent Manager.
evidence_quote: Get an Expert-Vetted talent badge that's visible to Enterprise and Business Plus clients… Show up in expert-level talent client searches, and be invited first to privately-posted projects.

name: Identity Verification Badge
description: Blue checkmark added to a provider's profile after completing government-ID verification; costs 35 Connects, valid for 3 years, and is required to bid on U.S.-only or U.K.-only jobs.
evidence_quote: The identity verification badge is a blue check mark next to your name… You get the badge by spending 35 Connects and completing identity verification… The badge is valid for three years.

name: Connects Credits System
description: Virtual token economy where providers spend Connects to submit proposals, boost proposals, activate the Availability Badge, and purchase the identity verification badge; Connects cost $0.15 USD each, sold in bundles, with some free monthly allocations and badge-unlock bonuses.
evidence_quote: Connects are the virtual tokens freelancers use on Upwork to submit proposals for jobs, as well as for various ad products, such as boosted proposals and the Availability Badge… Connects cost $0.15 (USD) each and are sold in bundles.

name: Boosted Proposals
description: Pay-per-outcome auction where providers bid extra Connects on top of the base proposal cost to secure one of four highlighted slots at the top of a client's applicant list; Connects are only charged if the provider wins a slot or the client interacts with the boosted proposal.
evidence_quote: A Boosted Proposal is your way to move your proposal to the top of a client's list by using extra Connects… If you're one of the highest bidders, we'll highlight your proposal to the client by putting it in the top four slots and adding a 'Boosted' icon.

name: Boosted Profile (Search Promotion)
description: Pay-per-click profile promotion where providers bid Connects per click to appear in promoted search slots when clients browse for skills; charged only on client interaction (click, save, invite, hire, or video view); supports video intro for eligible providers.
evidence_quote: When a client views a relevant search page, our ad server runs an auction behind the scenes to determine which freelancers to show based on bid price and relevance… you're only charged if someone clicks through.

name: Availability Badge
description: Weekly Connects-funded 'Available now' badge displayed in search results and client recommendations; providers set a maximum weekly Connects budget and the badge auto-pauses if market price exceeds the cap; claimed to increase job invites by up to 70%.
evidence_quote: The Availability Badge is a bright purple 'Available now' icon… It boosts your visibility to clients and can increase job invites by up to 70%. The Availability Badge costs Connects to keep active each week.

name: Provider Analytics Dashboard (Stats & Trends)
description: Dashboard showing 12-month earnings, current JSS with improvement insights, profile views, invitations, proposal funnel (sent/viewed/interviews/hires), boosted vs. organic split, client retention signals, current Connects balance, and badge progression tracker.
evidence_quote: Stats and trends help you track your progress… Profile views: How many people checked out your profile… Proposals: Sent, Viewed, Interviews, Hires… It also shows whether the proposals, views, and responses were boosted or organic.

name: Freelancer Plus Subscription
description: Paid monthly membership for providers; grants 100 Connects/month, real-time job alerts, expanded proposal/client insights, 0% service fee on Direct Contracts, unlimited access to Uma AI assistant, profile-active-while-on-break toggle, earnings-hiding option, and custom profile URL.
evidence_quote: Get 100 Connects each month… Instant job alerts… Proposal and client insights: Expanded data on applicants, bids, and hiring activity… Enjoy a 0% freelancer service fee when bringing new clients to Upwork via Direct Contracts.

name: Freelancer Service Fee
description: Variable platform take-rate (0%–15%) applied per contract to provider earnings; set at contract creation and fixed for that contract's lifetime; visible in the offer/proposal flow before commitment; exceptions for Upwork Payroll, Any Hire, Direct Contracts, and Enterprise.
evidence_quote: The fee ranges from 0% to 15% per contract… The Freelancer Service Fee is set based on factors that help support a balanced and competitive environment across different types of work. Once your contract begins, the fee is fixed.

name: Project Catalog (Provider-Created Fixed-Price Listings)
description: Provider-authored, pre-scoped service listings with title, images, video, PDF samples, pricing tiers, and add-ons; clients browse and buy directly without a proposal; Upwork reviews all listings before publication.
evidence_quote: Project Catalog is where you let clients come to you… Clients find you by searching for the skills and services you offer. You'll personalize your project with a title, text, images, a video, and PDF work samples.

name: Proposal Submission Flow (Talent Marketplace)
description: Provider submits a proposal to a client-posted job by spending a variable number of Connects (shown before submission); the proposal includes a cover letter, hourly rate or fixed-price bid, and optional boost; proposal insights show how many others applied.
evidence_quote: Submit a proposal to a specific job post. The number of Connects you'll need varies per job and can change during the time the job is posted. We consider a range of factors, including project size, scope, and market demand.

name: Earnings Security Holds (Payment Protection)
description: Hourly contract earnings become available 10 days after the billing week ends (the following Wednesday); fixed-price milestone funds clear 5 days after client approval; Top Rated providers are eligible for faster payment on hourly contracts.
evidence_quote: Hourly contracts: Hours billed weekly (Monday–Sunday). Earnings available ten days later (the following Wednesday)… Fixed-price contracts: Funds released five days after a client approves a milestone.

name: Withdrawal Methods
description: Providers can withdraw earnings via U.S. ACH (free), local bank transfer ($0.99), U.S. wire ($50), Instant Pay ($2), PayPal, Payoneer (non-U.S.), or M-Pesa (Kenya); automatic withdrawal schedules and reserve balance options are configurable.
evidence_quote: Direct to U.S. Bank (ACH) — Free… Direct to Local Bank (outside of U.S.) — $0.99 USD per transfer… U.S. Dollar Wire Transfer — $50.00 USD per transfer… Instant Pay for U.S. Freelancers — $2.00 USD per transfer.

name: Dispute Resolution & Arbitration
description: Fixed-price contract disputes proceed through Upwork-mediated dispute assistance; if unresolved, both parties can opt into binding third-party arbitration via Brief (neutral provider); loser-pays model splits cost, with Upwork subsidizing arbitration on contracts over $20,000.
evidence_quote: Arbitration is part of the dispute process that's available on fixed-price contracts if a freelancer and client are unable to reach an agreement… A neutral, third-party company, Brief, provides the arbitration service.

name: Badge-Gated Connects Bonuses
description: Providers receive a one-time grant of 30 free Connects for each earned badge (Rising Talent, Top Rated, Top Rated Plus), combinable up to 90 Connects if badges are skipped; creates a direct incentive linkage between reputation tier and bidding currency.
evidence_quote: You earn 30 free Connects for each badge: Rising Talent, Top Rated, and Top Rated Plus… If you become Top Rated but didn't get the Rising Talent badge, you'll get 60 Connects when you become Top Rated.

name: Proposal & Client Insights (Freelancer Plus)
description: Expanded bidding intelligence visible only to Freelancer Plus subscribers, showing number of applicants, current bid range, and client hiring activity to help providers calibrate their Connects spend and proposal strategy.
evidence_quote: Proposal and client insights: Expanded data on applicants, bids, and hiring activity that can help you refine your bidding and proposal strategy.

name: Consultation Offering
description: Paid 1-on-1 session product that Rising Talent and above can offer directly to clients; provider sets price and availability; managed through a dedicated contract workroom; governed by additional guidelines.
evidence_quote: Ability to offer consultations to share expertise with clients [listed as a Top Rated benefit].

name: Direct Contracts (Bring-Your-Own-Client)
description: Providers can onboard existing off-platform clients onto Upwork under a reduced-fee or zero-fee contract; Freelancer Plus members pay 0% service fee on Direct Contracts; Direct Contract outcomes count toward JSS.
evidence_quote: Direct contract benefits: Enjoy a 0% freelancer service fee when bringing new clients to Upwork via Direct Contracts.

name: Automatic Contract Closure & Inactivity Management
description: Upwork automatically closes contracts after prolonged inactivity; unmanaged sudden closures can negatively impact JSS visibility; providers are expected to actively manage contract state and communicate with clients to trigger mutual closure.
evidence_quote: Upwork now automatically closes contracts after a period of prolonged inactivity… Unmanaged, sudden closures can potentially impact your profile metrics, such as the visibility of your Job Success Score (JSS).
